Bug_Details: The type of the array parameter of Collection.toArray needs to be compatible with the array type
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the'showBug' method where a List<String> is incorrectly converted to an Integer array, and then cast to a String array, causing a ClassCastException.
Seed_Compilation_Fail_Details:
../prone_clean_java_code/result_Prone_20/seed_Prone_20.java:9: error: incompatible types: Integer[] cannot be converted to String[]
        return (String[]) result; // This will cause a ClassCastException
                          ^
1 error
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the showBug method with a List<String>. Inside showBug, the List<String> is incorrectly converted to an Integer array, which leads to a ClassCastException when attempting to cast it back to a String array.
